# reolink_ftp (Resource)

Manages the Reolink Ftp enable switch while preserving existing settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "reolink_ftp_configuration" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "reolink_ftp_configuration_revision" {
  type = string
}

resource "reolink_ftp" "front" {
  camera                 = "front"
  enabled                = false
  configuration          = var.reolink_ftp_configuration
  configuration_revision = var.reolink_ftp_configuration_revision
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `camera` (String) Key in the provider cameras map.
- `configuration` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only JSON object containing the desired delivery configuration. Supply it through a sensitive Terraform value or external secret manager.
- `configuration_revision` (String) Non-secret revision marker used to trigger updates when the write-only configuration changes.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Reolink Ftp delivery is enabled.

### Optional

- `schedule` (String) Native JSON schedule object, preserving legacy and V20 alarm tables exactly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reolink_ftp.front front
```
